snippet.title: Stack the Countries
snippet.description:
Stack the Countries makes learning about the world fun!  Watch the countries actually come to life in this colorful and dynamic game! 

As you learn country capitals, landmarks, geographic locations and more, you can actually touch, move and drop the animated countries anywhere on the screen. Carefully build a stack of countries that reaches the checkered line to win each level.

You earn a random country for every successfully completed level.  All of your countries appear on your own personalized maps of the continents.  Try to collect all 192!  As you earn more countries, you begin to unlock the free bonus games: Map It! and Pile Up!  Three games in one!

See Stack the Countries in the iTunes App Store here:
http://bit.ly/edD1Do
